5 Tips to Prevent HMPV

1. Wash hands with soap for 20 secs often. 
2. Use sanitizer with 60% alcohol if soap isn't available. 
3.Avoid touching face with unwashed hands. 
4.Cover coughs/sneezes with tissue or elbow. 
5. Wear masks in crowd
